title: PresenceRecord
description: The MCP's record of one sovereign life's presence (spec 5.15.2, Wave M design). It is the value under the key life_id in the KV bucket geldar-presence (PRESENCE_BUCKET). awake while a wait is open or a call came within the lease; dim after that; hibernating after the hibernate window, with desired_body down. The player host starts the Body on up and stops it on down.

at.description: When the MCP wrote this record.
